messages.subject: Mitr Phol | Bioenergy, sustainability and country stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mitr Phol Leadership and Talent Team,

Mitr Phol's combination of sugar, biomass power, ethanol and international operations makes the group highly relevant to my background across industrial operations, energy transition and stakeholder strategy.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent experience includes governance and external engagement around a large solar and battery-storage platform, carbon-data readiness, and multi-agency environmental and operating matters. I also manage community-sensitive issues and strategic partnerships in a remote industrial setting.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Sustainability, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships or country operations. I have attached a Mitr Phol-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
